evals.name: create-custom-table
evals.prompt: Create a custom 'products' table with Howdy QB with columns: id (auto-increment primary key), name (VARCHAR 200, required), price (DECIMAL 10,2), status (ENUM draft/published), created_at (timestamp with CURRENT_TIMESTAMP).
evals.expected_output: Use DB::create('products')->column('id')->bigInt()->unsigned()->autoIncrement()->primary() chain. Column 'name' uses string(200)->required(). 'price' uses decimal(10,2)->default(0.00). 'status' uses enum(['draft','published'])->default('draft'). 'created_at' uses timestamp('now'). Ends with ->execute(). No prefix in table name.

evals.name: select-with-joins-and-where
evals.prompt: Query orders with user names where status is completed, ordered by total descending, with a limit of 10.
evals.expected_output: Use DB::select('o.id', 'o.total', 'u.name')->from('orders o')->join('users u', 'o.user_id', 'u.id')->where('o.status', '=', 'completed')->orderBy('o.total', 'DESC')->limit(10)->get(). Returns array of assoc arrays.

evals.name: pagination-with-offset
evals.prompt: Query the second page of submissions with 20 per page and a status filter.
evals.expected_output: Two queries: a COUNT query with DB::select()->from('submissions')->count('id', 'total')->where('status', '=', 'active')->get() for pagination metadata, then a data query with limit(20)->offset(20)->orderBy('created_at', 'DESC')->get(). Where clause applied to both.

evals.name: batch-insert-multiple-rows
evals.prompt: Insert three new orders into the orders table at once with Howdy QB.
evals.expected_output: DB::insert('orders', [['user_id' => 1, 'total' => 99.99], ['user_id' => 2, 'total' => 49.99], ['user_id' => 3, 'total' => 25.00]])->execute(). Multi-row array of assoc arrays. Prepared statement values.

evals.name: alter-table-add-column
evals.prompt: Add a 'discount_price' DECIMAL(10,2) nullable column to the products table.
evals.expected_output: DB::alter('products')->add('discount_price')->decimal(10, 2)->nullable()->execute(). Uses fluent ALTER API. Idempotent — checks column existence.
